test_datetime64_comparisons: test datetime64 array-like comparison operations including scalar and arraylike invalid comparisons
test_datetime64_arithmetic: test datetime64 arithmetic operations including addition and subtraction of timedelta-like scalars and arrays
test_datetime64_dateoffset_arithmetic: test datetime64 DateOffset arithmetic with tick and non-tick offsets like Day Hour MonthEnd
test_datetime64_overflow_handling: test datetime64 overflow handling for edge cases near Timestamp.min and Timestamp.max boundaries
test_datetimeindex_arithmetic: test DatetimeIndex arithmetic operations with TimedeltaIndex including add subtract and in-place operators
test_nat_comparisons: test NaT comparison behavior across datetime64 Series DatetimeIndex and scalar Timestamp values
test_datetime64_tzaware_comparisons: test datetime64 comparison operations with timezone-aware and timezone-naive DatetimeIndex objects
test_datetime64_addsub_offset_array: test datetime64 addition and subtraction with arrays of DateOffset objects elementwise
test_datetime64_non_nano_nat_scalars: test non-nanosecond datetime64 Series arithmetic with numpy NaT scalars of various units
test_datetime64_dst_transitions: test datetime64 DateOffset arithmetic near DST transition boundaries in timezone-aware indices
